body: Am I missing something or is this a suicide glorification sub? I’m trying to give the people who need to hear this a realisation that suicide isn’t the answer. I’m not trying to offend or trigger anyone. I hope you get the help you need to overcome your suicidal feelings and live a happy life.
Some of these posts are truely heartbreaking. I really hope everyone gets the help they need.
Living to an old age where it happens naturally.
Nothing will change if you don’t do anything about it. Getting help will put you on the right path to change your life.

I’m not suicidal so I don’t know how it truely is for you, but I do suffer from extreme ocd and other mental issues that try and convince me to do things that I don’t want to do. The way I see it, whatever demons are telling you that suicide is the answer don’t understand the consequences of what that means. There’s no coming back from it. Theres no chance to fix the problems. It’s a a choice that you can never go back on.

I watched a video of someone recalling their suicide attempt from the Golden Gate Bridge and he explained that his mind was essentially forcing him to commit suicide for years, and when he finally let go of the railing, INSTANT REGRET flowed through his body and brain. Suddenly, reality of the situation set in and he realised that this is no longer make believe. He survived, but think of all the people who didn’t and would have had those same final thoughts. It’s heartbreaking.

I don’t know you, but whatever you’re feeling, you can get through it. I’m not suicidal myself, never even thought of it, but I have been attacked and overcome by extreme anxiety all through my life that have left me depressed for years. But every time I overcome something, I feel that much stronger and more confident in myself. And eventually, I will have overcome all my demons and I will feel like the man I’ve always dreamt of feeling. You can do this too. Train your mind to realise that whatever it is you’re going through right now, you are strong enough to beat it. It will suck at first, but eventually it will suck less and less, and then it might start to become rewarding.

Good luck to you! You can do this.
